headline: Claude Code 2.1.329 resets saved scheduled tasks, and Codex 0.171.0 makes GPT-6.2 Sol the default model.

themes.title: New defaults change model and sandbox behavior
themes.facts: Claude Code 2.1.326 stops sandboxed commands from writing to some home folders by default, and Antigravity CLI 1.5.10 blocks sandboxed reads of `~/.config` by default ([v2.1.326](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.326), [1.5.10](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.5.10)). Codex 0.171.0 makes GPT-6.2 Sol the default model ([rust-v0.171.0](https://github.com/openai/codex/releases/tag/rust-v0.171.0)).
themes.so_what: re-check unattended jobs for blocked paths and the default model, and pin the settings you rely on.

themes.title: Saved scheduled tasks need a new schedule
themes.facts: Claude Code 2.1.329 makes most scheduled tasks saved by earlier versions need scheduling again in new signed-in sessions, though `--resume` of their own session still runs them ([v2.1.329](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.329)).
themes.so_what: schedule saved tasks again, or they may not run in new sessions.

themes.title: Permission and sandbox holes closed
themes.facts: Claude Code 2.1.328 closes an MCP header leak on redirect and a sandbox network-rule bypass ([v2.1.328](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/tag/v2.1.328)). Antigravity CLI 1.5.9 closes a sandbox proxy bypass and a leak of MCP headers after a redirect ([1.5.9](https://github.com/google-antigravity/antigravity-cli/releases/tag/1.5.9)). Codex 0.170.0 keeps sandbox restrictions through permission updates and child threads ([rust-v0.170.0](https://github.com/openai/codex/releases/tag/rust-v0.170.0)). Kilo Code v7.8.32 carries the hono and node-forge security updates ([v7.8.32](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/releases/tag/v7.8.32)).
themes.so_what: update Claude Code to 2.1.328 or later, Antigravity CLI to 1.5.10 or later and Kilo Code to 7.8.32 or later.

watch_next: Watch the next Claude Code notes for how scheduled tasks behave after the re-scheduling change, and the next Codex notes for whether the GPT-6.2 Sol default changes results.
